title: 4.8 Analyzing Graphs of Polynomial Functions

icans: I can use x-intercepts and end behavior to graph polynomial functions.
I can find turning points and local maximums and minimums.
I can tell whether a function is even, odd, or neither.

vocab: the __________ of a turning point that is higher / lower than all nearby points
a _____________ of degree n has at most n − 1 turning points
the number of times a factor __________; even multiplicity → the graph touches the x-axis, odd → it crosses

blocks.p: Now check in Desmos.  Local maximum ≈ ______________   Local minimum ≈ ______________

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Multiplicity: Even multiplicity: the graph _______________ the x-axis. Odd: it _______________.
